Class BallMovement

java.lang.Object
com.cuseto.pong.game.physics.BallMovement
public final class BallMovement extends Object
Pure physics for advancing a ball's position by one frame and resolving wall and paddle collisions.

Operates directly on the mutable Ball and Paddle instances passed in; boundaries and paddles are supplied explicitly by the caller rather than looked up from a session, so this can be exercised independently of GameSession.

  • Method Details

    • move

      public static void move(Ball ball, double elapsedSeconds, int minY, int maxY, Paddle leftPaddle, Paddle rightPaddle, boolean speedIncreaseEnabled)
      Advances the ball's position for one frame, then resolves any resulting collision with the top/bottom walls or either paddle.

      A wall collision reflects the ball back inside the boundary and reverses its vertical velocity. A paddle collision is detected by checking whether the ball's straight-line path between its previous and new position crosses the paddle's vertical span at the paddle's x-position, which avoids missed collisions when the ball moves more than its own size in a single frame; on collision the ball is reflected back outside the paddle and its horizontal velocity is reversed.

      Parameters:
      ball - the ball to move; its position and velocity are mutated in place
      elapsedSeconds - the amount of simulated time to advance, in seconds
      minY - the y-coordinate of the boundary the ball bounces off at the top (typically the arena's inner top boundary)
      maxY - the y-coordinate of the boundary the ball bounces off at the bottom (typically the arena's inner bottom boundary)
      leftPaddle - the left paddle, checked for a bounce as the ball crosses its x-position
      rightPaddle - the right paddle, checked for a bounce as the ball crosses its x-position
      speedIncreaseEnabled - whether paddle collisions increase horizontal speed
